title: Chain of Results
goal: Parse two numbers and add them. Two failure points, one honest signature.
hints: The signature promises Result - but two of these versions can never produce an Err.
Each ? is a checkpoint: pass on success, return the error on failure. Two parses, two question marks.
explanation: All three compile against the same honest signature - but only the ?-chain can keep its promise. The unwrap version panics on garbage (the error type in the signature is decoration it never uses), and the unwrap_or version launders 'x' into 0, returning Ok(20) where an Err belonged - the caller can no longer distinguish garbage from arithmetic. Two question marks: three characters of syntax, and every failure point reports truthfully.
